_why: Soft Path Travellers may start with DNA modifications and symbionts, and Frontier colonists typically receive the standard PEA package. Spacers usually carry a Micro-G modification. So these are creation-time content, not just an equipment catalogue.
_pas: PAS = Planetary Adaptation Syndrome, the condition most of these exist to counter.

dnams.name: EPAS/HIF ThinAir Modification
dnams.effect: Breathe Thin and Very Thin atmospheres without a compressor mask.
dnams.drawback: Any wound causes an extra one point of damage. Breathing thicker air without a filter mask causes oxygen intoxication, DM-1 to all checks.

dnams.name: Ariel Dry World Adaptation
dnams.effect: DM+2 on checks to resist hot weather.

dnams.name: FADS/ANGPTL6 Vostok Cold Weather Adaptation
dnams.effect: DM+2 on checks to resist cold weather.

dnams.name: SRR-564 Lut Hot Weather Adaptation
dnams.effect: DM+3 on checks to resist hot weather.
dnams._note: DM+3, one better than the Ariel Dry World modification, at the same TL, type and cost.

dnams.name: King Ultra Modification
dnams.effect: STR +1D and END +1D. On worlds of normal gravity and lower, gain the Fast Metabolism (+1) trait. Lungs function in King's much denser atmosphere.
dnams.drawback: In any atmosphere less than Dense (Atmosphere code below 8) the Traveller must wear a compressor mask, at the same cost as a respirator mask.
dnams._creation_impact: The only DNAM that rolls dice for characteristics. STR +1D and END +1D at creation is a swing of 2 to 12 points across two characteristics.

dnams.name: PAX/DLX Transcribe Micro-G Space Adaptation Modification
dnams.effect: DM+4 to Zero-G muscle atrophy checks. As a side effect, +1 STR in normal gravity environments and +2 STR in high gravity.
dnams._note: This is the modification the chargen text says most Spacers carry.

dnams.name: Micro-G (More Hands)
dnams.effect: Feet are restructured as a second pair of hands.
dnams.drawback: Speed reduced by 1 metre when walking on a solid surface under Low gravity or higher.

dnams.name: Planetary Environmental Adaptation (PEA)
dnams.effect: DM+4 to all PAS checks for the world it was designed for.
dnams._note: The standard package Frontier colonists typically receive. Tied to ONE named world -- it does nothing elsewhere.

dnams.name: Triton Ultra
dnams.effect: Grants the Amphibious, Enhanced Senses and Tough traits, plus the same cold resistance as the Cold Weather Adaptation.
dnams._note: Adapted for life in deep, cold oceans. The most trait-dense modification in the list.

dnams.name: Gender Reassignment
dnams.effect: Introduces no transgenic elements, so it is far more easily tolerated than other DNAMs and may be applied multiple times at only DM-1 to the END checks.
dnams._note: The only DNAM commonly available in the Core, where DNAMs are largely banned.

dnams.name: Retrograde
dnams.drawback: A further DM-2 on the END check for each additional DNAM after the first.
dnams._note: Strictly speaking DNAMs cannot be reversed; the price includes engineering a custom virus unique to the individual.

symbiont_infection.check: Easy END (4+), plus the Medic skill of the attendant
symbiont_infection.retry: a new check within 48 hours of a failed infection attempt is made at DM-2

symbionts.name: Arterial Maintenance Symbiont (AMS)
symbionts.effect: Blood cleaners grant DM+2 to AGEING rolls.
symbionts._creation_impact: Directly modifies the ageing roll, which 2300AD already delays to age 50. Worth surfacing in the generator rather than treating as equipment.

symbionts.name: Blood Clotting Agent (BCA)
symbionts.effect: Developed for the hyper-charged cardiovascular systems of King Ultra recipients; now in wider use.
symbionts._note: The extracted text does not state a numeric effect for BCA. Needs a re-read of printed p35 before it is exposed.

symbionts.name: Calcium Fixing Symbiont (CFS)
symbionts.effect: DM+2 to the check to avoid long-term negative effects from zero gravity; reduces bone decalcification in low and micro gravity.

symbionts.name: Targeted Anti-Microbial
symbionts._note: Appears ONLY in a cost line on printed p35 with no heading and no description of its own. Either a symbiont whose write-up was cut, or a stray line. Do not expose until confirmed against the page image.

symbionts.name: Digestive Enhancing Symbiont (DES)
symbionts.effect: DM+1 on PAS checks, in addition to any modifiers from DNA modifications or other symbionts. Developed for specific worlds.

_OPEN_QUESTIONS: An example reading 'a pistol shot causing 3D damage normally would cause 3D+3 damage' sits in the two-column text flow between the ThinAir and King Ultra entries. +1 per die matches ThinAir's 'any wound causes an extra one point of damage', so it is recorded there -- but the column interleaving means it could belong to King Ultra. Confirm against the page image before relying on it.
Blood Clotting Agent has no numeric effect in the extracted text.
Targeted Anti-Microbial has a cost line but no write-up.

None of this says HOW MANY DNAMs or symbionts a Soft Path Traveller starts with, or who pays. The colony descriptions in Book 2 are supposed to note which ones a given colony's people carry -- the same descriptions that hold the missing per-colony Survival modifiers.
